title: 第9章 外门告别第10章 练剑
slug: 我在修仙界竟然苟成大佬
content_zh:
走，带你去看看咱们凌霄峰！
于南兮轻快地招招手，领着宁知初踏上蜿蜒的山道。
别看凌霄峰占地广，其实冷清得很。
于南兮掰着手指细数，师父座下原本就四个徒弟，大师兄百里尧正在闭关冲击元婴呢。
宁知初闻言睁圆了眼睛，诧异道：元婴？大师兄这么厉害呀！
她忍不住凑近师姐：那师姐现在是什么境界呀？
我呀，于南兮俏皮地眨眨眼，刚结金丹就领到招收弟子的任务，这不就把你这个小可爱拐回来啦！
说着自己先笑弯了腰。
这说明我和师姐有缘嘛！
宁知初装模作样地拱手作揖，逗得于南兮又笑出声来。
转过一片青竹林，于南兮如数家珍地继续介绍：二师兄司瑾淮也是金丹，正在外游历。
四师弟池骁筑基后期，也跟二师兄一样在外头野呢。
她晃了晃手中的传音玉简，不过我刚给他们传了消息，保准那两个人会赶回来看小师妹。
没走多远，忽然停在一处开满夕雾花的平台，于南兮展开双臂：到啦！
你看这处如何？灵气比主峰都浓郁三分，离师父的洞府就隔着两道山涧。
她指尖轻点，瞧见没？上头那片云遮着的是大师兄的洞府，左边竹海里头是二师兄的，山腰上那个，那就是池骁的洞府。
宁知初深吸一口带着花香的灵气：师姐挑的地方肯定好，我就要这儿啦！
真不再看看？后山还有处临瀑的......
这儿就很好！
宁知初忽然想起什么，拽了拽于南兮的衣袖，师姐，我得回外门跟朋友们道个别。

于南兮顺手摸了摸她头顶的小啾啾：正好要去执事阁给你换身份玉牌，师姐带你御剑去！
说罢掐诀唤出本命飞剑，二人踏上飞剑，
走喽！
于南兮指尖一引，长剑凌空而起，载着宁知初化作一道流光，转眼便落在外门的小院前。
夜色微凉，院子里，慕陶陶正揉着肚子慢悠悠地踱步。
陶陶，这么晚还不休息呀？宁知初笑着走近。
嗐，还不是怪你！
慕陶陶哼哼两声，拍了拍圆滚滚的肚子，晚上那顿烧烤吃撑了，得走走消消食。
让你贪嘴，现在知道难受了吧？宁知初无语摇头。
那能怪我吗？谁让你手艺那么好！
慕陶陶理直气壮地甩锅，随即又好奇道，对了，你们刚刚去哪儿了？神神秘秘的。
content_en:
Come, let me take you to see our Lingxiao Peak!
Yu Nanxi waved briskly and led Ning Zhichu onto the winding mountain road.
Although Lingxiao Peak occupies a large area, it is actually very deserted.
Yu Nanxi counted on his fingers. There were originally four disciples under his master. The senior brother Baili Yao was in seclusion to attack the Nascent Soul.
When Ning Zhichu heard this, his eyes widened and he said in surprise: Nascent Soul? Senior brother is so powerful!
She couldn't help but get closer to her senior sister: What state is senior sister in now?
I, Yu Nanxi winked playfully, and I was given the task of recruiting disciples as soon as I formed the golden elixir. I am going to bring back this little cutie like you!
As he spoke, he smiled and bent over.
This shows that my senior sister and I are destined!
Ning Zhichu pretended to bow his hands, making Yu Nanxi laugh again.
Turning around a green bamboo forest, Yu Nanxi continued to introduce the treasures: Second senior brother Si Jinhuai is also a golden elixir and is traveling abroad.
In the late stage of foundation building, the fourth junior brother Chi Xiao was also out in the wild like the second senior brother.
She shook the sound transmission jade slip in her hand, but I just sent them the news, so I guarantee that those two people will rush back to see the little junior sister.
Not far away, he suddenly stopped at a platform full of evening mist flowers. Yu Nanxi spread his arms: Here we are!
What do you think of this place? The aura is three points richer than the main peak, and it is separated by two mountain streams from the master's cave.
She tapped her fingertips, did you see it? The cloud above is the senior brother's cave, the bamboo sea on the left is the second senior brother's, and the one on the mountainside is Chi Xiao's cave.
Ning Zhichu took a deep breath of the floral-scented aura: The place chosen by senior sister must be good, I want it here!
Really don’t want to look at it anymore? There is also a waterfall in the back mountain...
It's great here!
Ning Zhichu suddenly remembered something and tugged on Yu Nanxi's sleeve, Senior sister, I have to go back to the outer door to say goodbye to my friends.
Yu Nanxi casually touched the little tweet on her head: I am going to the Deacon Pavilion to change your identity jade badge. Senior sister will take you to wield the sword!
After saying this, he summoned the flying sword of his destiny, and the two of them stepped on the flying sword.
Let's go!
Yu Nanxi pointed his fingertips, and the long sword rose into the air, carrying Ning Zhichu and transformed into a stream of light, and landed in front of the small courtyard of the outer gate in the blink of an eye.
The night was slightly cool, and in the yard, Mu Taotao was pacing slowly, rubbing his belly.
Tao Tao, why don't you rest so late? Ning Zhichu approached with a smile.
Hey, it’s not your fault!
Mu Taotao hummed twice and patted his round belly. He was full from the barbecue dinner at night and had to take a walk to eat.
I made you greedy, now you know how uncomfortable it is, right? Ning Zhichu shook his head speechlessly.
Can you blame me? Who made you so good at your craftsmanship?
Mu Taotao waved the blame confidently, and then asked curiously, "By the way, where did you just go?" Mysterious.
